build.beforeDevCommand: npm run ensure:qdrant && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run ensure:qdrant && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
security.devCsp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost ws:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
